title: Hawking Licences for Streetside Ice Cream Vendors and Their Transferability and Validity Period
what_it_is: Hawking Licences for Streetside Ice Cream Vendors and Their Transferability and Validity Period

sections.label: Street Hawking Scheme licences
sections.summary: The Street Hawking Scheme gives temporary help through personal, non-transferable licences; 21 ice cream licences were issued in the past decade, 11 active as of January.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Street Hawking Scheme is intended to provide temporary assistance for unemployed individuals who are assessed to be best supported through a street hawking licence, rather than other financial assistance or employment matching schemes offered by a Social Service Office.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: All street hawking licences are therefore personal-to-holder and are non-transferable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In the past decade, 21 licences were issued under the Street Hawking Scheme for the sale of ice cream.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Of these, 11 remained active as of January this year.

sections.label: Eligibility for Street Hawking Scheme
sections.summary: Eligibility is based on people being unsuitable for other employment or the Social Service Office assessing it as the most appropriate temporary help.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On the eligibility, as I said in my main reply, the consideration is based on the fact that these people are not suitable for other forms of employment, or it is assessed by the Social Service Office as the most appropriate means to help them tide over a temporary period.

sections.label: Supporting hawkers beyond financial support
sections.summary: The Ministry says the first question is how best to help people find better longer-term careers, with hawker centres for those wanting long-term hawking.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: Is that something that the Ministry will consider letting to continue or even grow besides providing just a financial support for these hawkers?

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I think the fundamental question is this: for a person who may be in financial need, the first question we ask ourselves is, "What is the best way to support them for longer-term financial stability?" In present day Singapore, we do have hawker centres and we are building more hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For those who want to take on hawking as a longer-term job that they want to do, it probably will be better for them to be in a hawker centre where there are better facilities and for them to have a more fixed customer catchment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: This is where if there are funfairs or there are trade fairs, there are still people who are then given licences to participate in trade fairs to add to the festivity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But I would say that, fundamentally, the first question is to see how best we can help them to find a better career, where there are better job prospects for the longer term, and career stability.
